title: Data-driven control of linear systems using quantized data
summary: This paper studies data-driven stabilization of unknown discrete-time linear systems using only quantized state measurements that take values in finite sets. The proposed approach consists of two stages. In the controller design stage, we collect quantized data while maintaining a prescribed quantization error bound and use them to formulate a semidefinite program (SDP). We establish a verifiable condition under which any feasible solution to the SDP yields a stabilizing feedback gain, and show that a stabilizing gain can always be obtained when the quantization error is sufficiently small.…
